statusForm.title: Change account status

effects.active: Can sign in and use the system.
effects.inactive: Turned off. Use this when the person has left the society. They can't sign in.
effects.suspended: Blocked for now. They can't sign in until set back to Active.

statusForm.blockWarning: {name} will lose access right away and can't sign in until the account is set back to Active.

reset.title: Reset password

steps.password: The password is set back to the mobile number registered on this account.
steps.change: They must choose a new password right after signing in.
steps.signOut: They are signed out everywhere, and a lock from wrong passwords is cleared.

signInHint.member: Tell them to sign in with their member number and their registered mobile number as the password.
signInHint.admin: Tell them to sign in with their staff ID or email and their registered mobile number as the password.

reset.notActive: This account is {status}, so they still can't sign in until it is Active.
reset.confirm: I have checked that this request really comes from {name}.
reset.success: Password reset for {name}. They can now sign in with their registered mobile number.

login.title: Login account
login.firstPassword: Still the first password (mobile number); must change it after signing in
login.none: No login account is linked to this member.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.statusGeneric: Couldn't change the status. Please try again.
errors.resetGeneric: Couldn't reset the password. Please try again.
